parsed.internal_thinking: Alice has reached 5 VP and won the game. I was one turn away from playing my third knight for Largest Army and hitting 5 VP myself. Alice played it well by blocking my ore access and keeping the pressure on. Bob's framing worked just enough to keep the heat on me. I'll acknowledge the close finish and exit.
